def paint(n: int, ops: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
    import heapq

    m = len(ops)
    events = []
    for i, op in enumerate(ops):
        events.append((op[1], i, 1))
        events.append((op[2] + 1, i, 0))
    events.sort()

    size = 1
    while size < m:
        size <<= 1

    tree = [0] * (2 * size)
    active_erase = [False] * m
    erase_heap = []
    counts = {}

    j = 0
    while j < len(events):
        x = events[j][0]

        while j < len(events) and events[j][0] == x:
            _, i, entering = events[j]
            op = ops[i]

            if op[0] == 0:
                active_erase[i] = bool(entering)
                if entering:
                    heapq.heappush(erase_heap, -i)
            else:
                p = size + i
                tree[p] = op[3] if entering else 0
                p >>= 1
                while p:
                    value = max(tree[p << 1], tree[p << 1 | 1])
                    if tree[p] == value:
                        break
                    tree[p] = value
                    p >>= 1

            j += 1

        while erase_heap and not active_erase[-erase_heap[0]]:
            heapq.heappop(erase_heap)

        if j == len(events):
            break

        left = size + (-erase_heap[0] + 1 if erase_heap else 0)
        right = size + m
        colour = 0

        while left < right:
            if left & 1:
                colour = max(colour, tree[left])
                left += 1
            if right & 1:
                right -= 1
                colour = max(colour, tree[right])
            left >>= 1
            right >>= 1

        if colour:
            counts[colour] = counts.get(colour, 0) + events[j][0] - x

    return [[colour, counts[colour]] for colour in sorted(counts)]
